# Issue templates

[bug_report.md](bug_report.md) asks for the software/hardware versions, selected
backend and revision, a synthetic reproducer, and expected versus observed behavior.
Performance reports should also include shape, baseline, timer scope and raw JSON.

Edit the template when changing what maintainers need to reproduce an issue.
Keep credentials and private inputs out of reports. Follow
[SECURITY](../../SECURITY.md) for vulnerability reporting.
